title: The Plague Doctor Myth
sentences: The famous beaked plague mask didn't exist during the Black Death.
It showed up about three hundred years later.
The costume is usually credited to a French doctor, Charles de Lorme, in the sixteen hundreds.
The beak was stuffed with herbs and spices.
Doctors believed bad air carried the disease.
It didn't work, but the image stuck.
caption:
The famous beaked plague mask didn’t exist during the Black Death. It showed up about 300 years later.
